blockingFindings.description: V219 crouch and sit renders continue to expose the upper surfaces of both white trouser thighs. The front apron falls below and to the outside of the raised knees rather than covering both thighs.
V219 left and right profile renders still show the front apron hem and its pointed end projecting forward beyond the leg silhouette.
V219 prone render still shows diverging inner and outer lilac-edged hem contours under the pelvis, so the apron edge reads as doubled.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
